submitted.rationale: Mg–Sb–O phases are wide-gap: Mg²⁺ is optically inactive and MgSb2O6 trirutile has a gap of about 4 eV or more, so they absorb little at 2.4 eV. All measured EQEs were at noise level (≤2.5e-4 %). They rose slightly toward the Sb-rich end, and the highest value was at index 26 (Sb 0.757), possibly from Sb-oxide/defect absorption.

rejected.reason: EQE 1.6e-4 %, near MgSb2O6 composition, below index 26
